title.jcr:title: Macnica Ships MEP100 SmartNIC Solution as IBC2024 Approaches

text_intro.text: The hardware-accelerated SmartNIC solution, which drives SMPTE ST 2110 processing for on-prem workflows and now supports JPEG-XS, will receive its EMEA region debut

heading_1.jcr:title: Files available for download - MEP100 SmartNIC Data Sheet

text_1.text:
SOLANA BEACH, CALIFORNIA, September 3, 2024 — Macnica is now shipping its MEP100 SmartNIC solution in advance of IBC 2024 (International Broadcasting Convention) this month, with the first units now operational within a major U.S-based global broadcaster’s on-premise media workflows. Formally introduced at NAB Show in April, IBC marks the EMEA debut of the 100Gb hardware device, which drives ST 2110 media processing, stream protection and bandwidth utilization in a powerful, compact form factor. Macnica exhibits at Stand 14.D05.

 

Designed to meet the growing demand for IP solutions in the broadcast and ProAV industries, the MEP100 from Macnica was built to meet the needs of broadcasters establishing ST 2110 networks in their facilities. The MEP100 is interoperable with hardware and software products, offering developers a diverse creative platform for the broadcast and ProAV industries. The MEP100 also pairs naturally with Macnica’s M2S solution, which extends ST 2110 and IPMX workflows to streaming media networks and connects to all hardware points including common IT systems and computers. MEP100 customers will receive the M2S SDK at no additional cost.

 

New for IBC, Macnica has added JPEG-XS compression technology through its FPGA-based on-board architecture, making it possible to manage compressed ST 2110 streams alongside uncompressed streams. JPEG-XS compression delivers visually lossless quality, allowing customers to preserve bandwidth through compressed while maintaining sub-frame latency. Macnica will demonstrate the MEP100’s high-performance benefits in an on-booth exhibit of an end-to-end ST 2110 4K/HD networking ecosystem in its IBC stand in the RAI Amsterdam (September 13-16).

 

Macnica has equipped the MEP100 SmartNIC card with powerful resources to optimize performance and reliability of uncompressed media transport over ST 2110 IP networks. That begins with an FPGA hardware acceleration engine that offers product developers significant advantages over software-based alternatives. For example, ST 2110 IP packets are processed within the MEP100’s FPGA IP core architecture, including processing of 2022-7 Seamless Protection Switching, freeing valuable CPU and memory bandwidth resources for the intended application.

 

“The MEP100 brings real-time reliability and performance to the ST 2110 SmartNIC market, significantly outperforming general-purpose cards that lack flexibility and advanced features,” said Andrew Starks, Director of Product Development, Macnica. “Its high-efficiency FPGA design alone reduces traffic on the host computer by roughly 50 percent. The MEP100’s professional feature set provides everything the developer needs to realize their visions for high-end hardware products.”

 

Operationally, the MEP100’s full ST 2110 stack transfers video, audio and data directly to and from GPU memory or to application memory through kernel bypass technology. Paired with dedicated PTP acceleration, network path redundancy, on-board JPEG-XS compression and the M2S SDK, the MEP100 includes everything required for seamless ST 2110 integration with the customer’s application.

 

About Macnica

Macnica Technology, a leader in live video over IP transport technologies and creator of hardware and software APIs that implement SMPTE ST 2110, AMWA NMOS and IPMX standards, is a division of Macnica Americas, Inc. based in Solana Beach, Calif., a North American subsidiary of $10 Billion Macnica, Inc. Macnica focuses on the specialized technology areas of video/imaging and networking/storage to better support customers trying to develop products and services using these technologies. Macnica offers products at various levels of integration: component-level semiconductor devices, FPGA IP, boards and modules, software and total solutions. Visit the company’s website at www.macnicatech.com

title_text.jcr:title: Powerful, Efficient, and Compact Personnel Access Options

image.alt: IEI Intelligent Body Temperature Monitoring Solution

text.text:
IEI has engineered a thermal body temperature monitoring solution with the intelligence to identify in real-time personnel in a crowd who have elevated temperatures for building/area access purposes. The system has three primary components: Thermal camera(s), a high-performance Intel®-based panel PC, and software utilizing AI capabilities. Customers can select options for the camera and panel PC to scale performance and price.

Faces are detected, foreheads scanned for temperature to within +/- 0.3 degrees C, and those with elevated temperatures are identified with color-coded alarm status and reported along with optional snapshots.

Applications

  • Business and Retail
  • Transportation and Infrastructure (schools, arenas, train stations, etc.)
  • Government and Hospitals

text.text:
IEI Smart Healthcare Panel PC’s, Terminals and Computing

IEI medical solutions not only offers powerful and useful devices but also provides a practical total solution to advance medical technology. IEI healthcare solutions aim to reduce human error and create a paperless environment by utilizing IEI smart medical products. The highly modular design helps users manage various situations in a flexible way and enhance work efficiency in their daily routine.

IEI has several award-winning solutions including medical panel computers, terminals, and computing solutions. The computing solutions also include AI edge-based intelligent platforms with accelerators.

The IEI POCi-W24C-ULT5 24-inch Intelligent Point of Care Terminal

IEI now offers a profoundly configurable medical panel PC with slots that can take a variety of useful add-ons. All within the same slot, one can choose to add: a PoE card, video capture card, Isolation I/O card, medical-grade power supply, or a battery.

Additionally, IEI has developed their own DICOM module preset for visual consistency.

text_1294687825.text: This panel PC also features a powerful Intel 14nm i7 processor, aluminum bezel (IP66), Chemical etching AG coating, and a PCIe x4 expansion slot along with the DICOM preset module.
